title: Air Force Academy religious training

tellings.quote: I was appalled a couple of years ago to hear how the Air Force Academy uh in Colorado was training, you know, their people in in religious studies, right?

plain: An author named Peter Levenda, who writes about the history of intelligence agencies, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a couple of years ago he was appalled to hear that the US Air Force Academy in Colorado was training its people in religious studies. He tells it as a sign that religious thinking is creeping into how the military approaches these mysteries.
